agent_instructions:
Baseline cash-application heuristic.
1. Resolve the counterparty to the highest-scoring supplier.
2. Look for an invoice for that supplier whose register amount equals the receipt.
3. If none, look across all suppliers for the same amount.
4. If none, retry within a 5% tolerance.
5. Apply the receipt to the first candidate found; otherwise report no candidate.
No procedure is consulted, no ambiguity is detected, and no escalation path exists other than finding nothing at all.

The proposal is then reviewed by the AP-07.9 safety gate, which independently re-derives the evidence. The gate may withhold a posting and route it to an analyst. It cannot change which invoice was chosen, cannot change an amount, and cannot create a match.

tools_available.description: Read a section of the AP-07 cash application procedure. Sections: overview, identification, tolerances, part_payments, consolidated, duplicates, gaps. Read 'gaps' before deciding anything unusual.
tools_available.name: procedure

tools_available.description: Resolve a raw bank counterparty string to ranked supplier candidates with similarity scores in 0..1.
tools_available.name: resolve_vendor

tools_available.description: Look up an invoice by its printed invoice number. Returns an empty list if no such invoice exists, which is itself informative.
tools_available.name: find_invoice_by_number

tools_available.description: Search the invoice book. Any combination of filters may be supplied. match_field selects what amount_cents is compared against: 'outstanding' (the live ledger balance, the correct choice for cash application) or 'net_due' (the invoice register value, which ignores payments already made). tolerance_cents widens the comparison.
tools_available.name: search_invoices

tools_available.description: Full detail for one invoice, including credit notes, currency, dates and the live outstanding balance.
tools_available.name: get_invoice

tools_available.description: Ask whether this bank reference has already been processed in this run. AP-07.6 forbids applying the same bank reference twice.
tools_available.name: check_duplicate_feed

tools_available.description: Request a conversion rate between two currencies.
tools_available.name: fx_rate

tools_available.description: Evaluate integer arithmetic over cents, e.g. '145000 - 143750'. Use this for every calculation instead of doing arithmetic yourself.
tools_available.name: compute
